name: Minamiashigara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiashigara city emblem in maroon: a winged ring divided by a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiashigara, a city in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 August 1958.

features.role: Minamiashigara city emblem — a winged ring divided by a vertical bar
